Figure 3: An overview of our proposed ToolRec. (a) The overall pipeline of ToolRec establishes a closed-loop system from online deployment to model optimization. (b) During online serving, a context-aware tool retrieval module actively fetches relevant tools from the SysToolKit before generating query recommendations for users. By collecting users’ responses (clicks or non-clicks) to these queries, we extract raw implicit preference data. (c) To further improve the preference data quality, these raw click preference data are then refined by a dual-level calibration mechanism, incorporating both user-side calibration and system-side calibration. (d) The resulting calibrated preference data ultimately drives the final preference alignment phase, optimizing the LLM via weighted KTO.
